description_en: Modifies the name and description of a policy route table
description_zh: 修改策略路由表的名称和描述信息
name: UpdateTransitRouterPolicyTable

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the policy routing table
parameters.name: policy_table_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the policy route table.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
策略路由表的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the policy route table.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
策略路由表的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request, including checks on permissions and instance status. Valid values:

false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, the policy route table is updated.
true: sends a dry run request. Only the check is performed, and the policy route table is not updated. Check items include whether required parameters are specified and the request format. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the request ID is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接更新策略路由表。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会直接更新策略路由表。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回对应请求ID
parameters.name: dry_run
